title_text: GOOD NEWS FOR ALL FILM LOVERS
credits_text:
A New Animated Cartoon Comedy by J. R. Bray
COL. HEEZA LIAR - GHOST BREAKER
THE PATHE EXCHANGE, Inc.
25 West 45th Street, New York
other_text: When an exhibitor runs a Bray cartoon you can hear the roars of laughter for blocks... See it and you'll have sore sides for a week. Joined with THE GREAT EARED BAT (Madagascar) to form 1000 feet of solid enjoyment.
description: A vintage advertisement for an animated comedy featuring Colonel Heeza Liar in a ghostly adventure, with playful cartoon illustrations and promotional text.
